items.title: Replace the SPA-shaped health false positive with a typed edge-health contract and make HSTS a tested live release invariant.
items.why: The staging /_health response is byte-identical to / and returns HTML, while production lacks Strict-Transport-Security even though the static security gate passes. Both are direct CANON-031 contradictions.
items.recipe: Add a Cloudflare Pages /_health function returning bounded JSON and no-store headers; add HSTS to the Pages header policy; make local/live validators require status, content type, body contract, and HSTS rather than HTTP 200 alone.

L1.recipe: Add a JSON /_health Pages function and HSTS header.

L2.recipe: Add unit/static tests for content type, bounded payload, no-store, and HSTS configuration.

L3.recipe: Extend staging/live release checks so SPA fallback HTML or missing HSTS fails closed with actionable evidence.

items.title: Turn service-worker support into a real controlled/registered/update lifecycle receipt instead of labeling API availability as readiness.
items.why: detectServiceWorkerReady() currently returns true when navigator merely exposes serviceWorker, and register-sw.js discards registration failures. The Home PWA chip can therefore claim browser readiness without a controller or successful registration.
items.recipe: Model supported, registered, controlled, update-ready, and failed states; emit a bounded browser event from registration; consume it in HomeV2; keep installation claims distinct from lifecycle readiness.

L1.recipe: Rename support semantics and require controller/registration evidence for ready.

L2.recipe: Emit and test registration success/failure/controller lifecycle states.

L3.recipe: Render a truthful actionable lifecycle receipt and preserve physical-install NO-GO language.

items.title: Make local progression durability observable with a bounded write-health journal instead of silently swallowing persistence failures.
items.why: Critical settings, career, mission, meta, supporter-cache, and cosmetic writes catch and discard storage errors. A quota or privacy-mode failure can erase progression while the UI continues to imply success.
items.recipe: Add a zero-dependency storage write/read contract with sanitized failure classes, bounded in-memory journal, last-success time, and persistence probe; route critical writes through it and surface an honest local-save degraded receipt without exposing values.

L1.recipe: Wrap settings and career writes with boolean receipts.

L2.recipe: Add bounded sanitized journal and cover critical progression keys.

L3.recipe: Surface player-visible degraded/recovered state, add quota/privacy fixtures, and prove no stored values leak into diagnostics.

items.title: Replace the three-second tutorial slideshow with observed-action mastery that advances on real move, shoot, dash, grenade, kill, and perk evidence.
items.why: TutorialOverlay auto-advances every three seconds, permanently dismisses, and vanishes after wave one regardless of player action. It can finish while a new player is still decoding the first control.
items.recipe: Derive a bounded tutorial evidence map from the existing command trace and run counters; auto-advance only after evidence, retain manual NEXT/SKIP, expose replayable practice reset, and keep keyboard/touch/controller labels.

L1.recipe: Stop timer advancement and add explicit completion actions.

L2.recipe: Wire move/shoot/dash/grenade evidence from existing trace calls.

L3.recipe: Include kill/perk mastery, accessible status copy, reset semantics, and cross-input regression tests.

items.title: Replace invisible null Suspense gaps with a reusable accessible loading and chunk-recovery boundary for player-critical panels.
items.why: More than twenty lazy panel sites render fallback={null}; slow or stale chunks create blank interaction gaps, and a rejected lazy import escalates to the global crash screen rather than a local recovery path.
items.recipe: Create one compact AsyncPanelBoundary with accessible loading status, local error capture, retry/reload action, and themed presentation; adopt it across game, HomeV2, pause, menu, and death surfaces with focused tests.

L1.recipe: Provide a visible role=status loading fallback for critical modals.

L2.recipe: Add a panel-level error boundary and retry/reload affordance.

L3.recipe: Adopt consistently across all lazy player surfaces and verify theme/input/accessibility behavior.
